page.overview:
Who is Headsman of Cellebos?

The Headsman of Cellebos, one of the most brutal of all of the World Eaters Heretic Astartes known to be active in the Jericho Reach, is an individual whose true name is unknown.

However, he has earned his dire moniker by the countless bloody deeds he has perpetrated across a hundred battlefields and more.

To be named as a target of the Headsman's ire is a truly horrifying prospect, for to date, none who have been so named have escaped their fate.

The Headsman is only ever known to have one target at a time, never announcing another until his boast is fulfilled and his victim's skull laid before the Brass Throne of Khorne.
